name: Titania
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Titania is a queen of the fairies in the lore of Britain. She is the wife of Oberon in the play of Shakespeare. A quarrel with the king makes him meddle in the love of two humans. Many rank her with the queen Mab. She keeps high rule over the fairy folk at court.

okr.objective: Record the fairy queen named Titania.
key_results: She is the wife of Oberon
